dedupe_keys.name: hub de datos de transporte publico en mexico codeando mexico

description: The Hub de Datos de Transporte Público en México, run by Codeando México, collects open data, learning resources and news on digitising public transport in Mexico. Its stated aim is to democratise access to the resources and skills needed to produce public transport data, since municipalities need such data to promote transit use and improve mobility. On 2026-09-29 its news listed new GTFS feeds, for example SEMOVI Oaxaca's Puerto Escondido and Salina Cruz feeds, route GTFS for Cabo San Lucas and the El Insurgente train in Mexico City, and an update of the canonical GTFS validator. Coverage: Mexican cities with published feeds. Format and access: a web hub linking GTFS feeds and guides. Licence and cost: free; licences follow each feed. Caveats: a hub of links and news, with feeds of uneven quality. It supports network flow and capacity planning models of Mexican transit. It relates to the Mobility Database and DigitalTransport4Africa records in the catalogue, which hold similar feeds elsewhere.
